subject: ss-plastic-surgery
title: Gynecomastia: Simon Grading, Workup and Correction

steps.say: Male breast enlargement is growing from a shifted hormone balance rather than a tumour. Estrogen action outweighing androgen action at the breast is driving ductal and stromal proliferation. Even fully virilized men are developing glandular tissue when the ratio tips.
steps.tx: **Gynecomastia** is benign proliferation of male breast glandular tissue from an altered **estrogen-to-androgen** activity ratio. **Estrogen** action outweighing **androgen** action grows ducts and stroma. The breast enlarges despite otherwise normal virilization, and tenderness often announces the active growth phase. True gynecomastia stays concentric and tender, unlike eccentric hard malignancy.

steps.say: Four Simon grades are mapping enlargement with skin excess as the key divider. Grade one is minor without excess skin, grade two a adds size alone, and grade two b adds redundant skin. Grade three is mimicking the female breast with severe redundancy.
steps.tx: **Simon classification** grades severity: **Grade 1** minor enlargement without skin excess, **Grade 2a** moderate without excess, **Grade 2b** moderate with excess, **Grade 3** marked enlargement with severe redundancy mimicking female breast. Skin excess is deciding whether excision alone suffices or skin reduction must join the operative plan.

steps.say: Three life periods are clustering harmless breast buds that usually resolve alone. Maternal estrogen is swelling neonatal breasts, the pubertal surge around thirteen to fourteen years is enlarging teenage tissue, and falling testosterone is growing senescent breasts. Reassurance is sufficing while observation continues.
steps.tx: Physiological peaks span **three** periods: **neonatal** buds from maternal **estrogen** transfer, **pubertal** surge around **13 to 14 years**, and **senescent** growth from declining testosterone. All three usually resolve without surgery. Observation with reassurance is managing these windows, with surgery reserved for persistent painful cases.

steps.say: Failing livers, kidneys, testes, and thyroids are all disturbing the hormone axis. Cirrhosis is impairing estrogen breakdown, Klinefelter forty seven XXY is starving tissue of androgen, and testicular tumours are secreting estrogen directly. Thyroid overactivity is shifting binding proteins and free hormone levels.
steps.tx: Pathology spans liver, kidney, gonad, and thyroid: **cirrhosis** impairs estrogen degradation, kidney disease disturbs the axis, **hypogonadism** including **Klinefelter 47,XXY** starves androgen, Leydig or Sertoli **tumours** secrete estrogen, and **thyrotoxicosis** shifts binding. Systematic workup with examination, hormones, and imaging precedes any knife in persistent cases.

steps.say: Common prescriptions are blocking androgen or adding estrogen without warning. Spironolactone with cimetidine is displacing androgen from its receptor, finasteride with ketoconazole is removing or halting androgen synthesis, and anabolic steroids with protease inhibitors are aromatizing or disturbing metabolism. Stopping the culprit is often reversing early disease.
steps.tx: Drugs trigger reversible growth: **spironolactone**, cimetidine, **finasteride**, ketoconazole, **anabolic steroids**, and protease inhibitors. Receptor blockade, synthesis halt, and aromatization each tip the ratio. Reviewing the medication list and stopping the culprit reverses early disease without any surgery. Early withdrawal works best before fibrosis fixes the gland permanently.

steps.say: Hidden scars at the pigment border are giving direct access to the gland. The Webster semicircular incision along the lower areolar edge is opening the inferior periareolar window. Sharp excision beneath the nipple is proceeding under full vision through this approach.
steps.tx: The **Webster incision** runs a semicircular inferior **periareolar** course along the lower areolar border. It gives direct exposure for sharp **glandular excision** beneath the nipple. The scar hides at the pigment junction while access stays wide enough for complete haemostatic excision.

steps.say: Over-excavation behind the nipple is collapsing into a permanent crater deformity. A one point zero centimetre disc of retroareolar tissue is deliberately preserved as a pedestal. The nipple is resting on this cushion instead of sinking into an empty bed.
steps.tx: A **1.0 cm** disc of **retroareolar tissue** must stay to prevent **saucerization**. Over-excavation collapses the nipple into a permanent **crater deformity**. Restraint behind the areola is preserving a firm pedestal for smooth lasting projection of the nipple. An empty bed guarantees the crater deformity, so the protective cushion is never sacrificed.

steps.say: Sharp edges around the excised disc are outlining the resection visibly. Suction-assisted or ultrasound-assisted feathering is blending the transitions into the surrounding chest wall. The step-off is disappearing as contouring smooths the whole masculine plane.
steps.tx: Combined suction-assisted or ultrasound-assisted liposuction with **contour feathering** blends the excised disc edges smoothly into the surrounding chest wall fat. **Contour** transitions smooth out and the step-off disappears. Excision removes the dense gland while circumferential **feathering** restores the smooth masculine plane. Symmetry with the opposite side is checked on the table before closure.
